sampling_unit: original C80 case, one frozen seed; descriptive post-hoc diagnosis
limits: One trajectory per arm; descriptive diagnostics only.
Pre-visit losses use different intermediate checkpoints; their mean is not a full-C80 training curve.
Update80 compares logged pre-update checkpointed training with final no-grad evaluation on the same case/seed. Same-parameter checkpointed/no-grad parity at final80 remains unverified.
Final-minus-previsit includes own and subsequent updates; it does not establish catastrophic forgetting or full-C80 divergence.
Final Adam moments do not identify per-component gradient conflicts or stability over every update.
No model or teacher forward, no training, no held-out fitting.
interpretation_annotation: Local post-review renamed the last-step comparison to distinguish logged checkpointed training from final no-grad evaluation. Numerical results unchanged; raw CPU artifact remains at the recorded PBS job.
